# gitlab_project_container_scanning (Resource)

The `gitlab_project_container_scanning` resource allows managing whether container scanning for registry is enabled on a project.

-> This resource requires a GitLab Ultimate license, and is available on GitLab.com, GitLab Self-Managed, and GitLab Dedicated.

~> [Container scanning for registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/application_security/container_scanning/#container-scanning-for-registry) automatically scans container images pushed to the project's container registry with the `latest` tag.

~> Using multiple `gitlab_project_container_scanning` resources for the same project may result in non-deterministic behavior, as each resource will attempt to manage the same setting.

~> When you destroy the resource, you can control if the container scanning for registry setting is kept or not. Set `keep_settings_on_destroy` to `true` (default) to leave the setting as last configured. Set `keep_settings_on_destroy` to `false` to reset it to its pre-Terraform value. The original value is saved in state when you create or import the resource. You can change the `keep_settings_on_destroy` value before destroying the resource to control this behavior.

**Upstream API**: [GitLab GraphQL API docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/#mutationsetcontainerscanningforregistry)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitlab_project" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "gitlab_project_container_scanning" "example" {
  project                                 = gitlab_project.example.id
  container_scanning_for_registry_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container_scanning_for_registry_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable container scanning for registry for the project. Requires a GitLab Ultimate license.
- `project` (String) The ID or full path of the project to change the container scanning for registry setting of.

### Optional

- `keep_settings_on_destroy` (Boolean) Set to `true` if the container scanning for registry setting should not be reset to its pre-Terraform value on destroy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this Terraform resource. In the format of `<project>`.

## Import

Starting in Terraform v1.5.0, you can use an [import block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import `gitlab_project_container_scanning`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = gitlab_project_container_scanning.example
  id = "see CLI command below for ID"
}
```

Importing using the CLI is supported with the following syntax:

```shell
# GitLab project container scanning for registry settings can be imported using the project ID or full path, e.g.
terraform import gitlab_project_container_scanning.example "12345"
```
